period_note: Half-Yearly filing used as Q2 per this dataset's convention; income-statement figures are CUMULATIVE 01 January to 30 June 2023 (the filing's own first P&L column); a separate discrete '01 April to 30 June' column also exists in the source and is not used, for consistency with the rest of the series. Column identification was cross-validated by matching this filing's own prior-year cumulative column against the already-recorded 2022_Q2.json figures line-by-line (profit paid on deposits 24,302,164,939; net investment income 15,236,890,960; income from shares 1,105,978,842; commission 4,901,350,802; other operating income 3,666,264,095; total operating income 24,910,484,698; total operating expenses 14,397,948,916; PBT 7,334,436,608; tax 4,134,508,164; PAT 3,199,928,444; EPS 1.99) -- every one matched exactly, confirming the first P&L column is the current-year (2023) cumulative. SOLO / STANDALONE basis (a Consolidated version incl. Islami Bank Securities Ltd and Islami Bank Capital Management Ltd also appears in the source and is not used). Source is a scanned/signed copy with no text layer, OCR'd via tesseract. Balance sheet ties exactly (total liabilities 1,810,844,940,374 + equity 69,385,861,721 = total assets 1,880,230,802,095, an exact match; the 5 deposit sub-lines and the 4 equity sub-lines each sum exactly to their totals; total liabilities is independently reproduced exactly from its own components). P&L operating-income and expense sub-lines sum exactly to their totals; PBT 7,755,519,227 minus 'Provision for taxation for the period' 4,469,913,487 (the full tax charge; 'Deferred tax' is a memo sub-component, not additive) reproduces PAT 3,285,605,740 exactly. The liabilities section's 'Mudaraba Bond' (31,000,000,000) is the parent of 'Perpetual bond' (11,000,000,000) and 'Redeemable subordinated bond' (20,000,000,000), which sum to it exactly. This interim filing does not disclose the absolute Classified Investment balance, only the provision held/movement against it (Note 11.1); classified_loans and npl_pct are therefore not available. Note 11.1's comparative column is the full prior year (FY2022); its Opening balance (59,880,560,000) matches the Opening balance already recorded for 2023 Q1 exactly, a further consistency check. All of this quarter's exported Note 11.1 figures are directly legible and reported as printed. Two smaller OCR issues were found and resolved during validation that do NOT affect any exported field: (1) Note 11.1's 'D. Provision made during the period' sub-item for Off-Balance-Sheet items is printed as a positive 720,830,000, which breaks both the sum-to-D-total check and the opening-plus-addition-equals-closing check for that sub-item; treating it as -720,830,000 (the OCR evidently dropped a minus sign/parenthesis) makes both checks tie exactly (785,140,000+3,237,160,000-720,830,000=3,301,470,000 matches D's own printed total, and the resulting Off-Balance-Sheet closing of 2,136,030,000-720,830,000=1,415,200,000 matches the printed closing exactly) -- D's total (3,301,470,000) and its Classified sub-item (3,237,160,000), the two figures used for this dataset's fields, were printed correctly throughout and needed no correction. (2) The P&L's 'Other provisions' sub-line is printed as 35,348,405 for the current period, which does not let Total Provision's three sub-items sum to the printed Total Provision; the Consolidated P&L in the same document independently prints this same line as 31,348,405 for the same period, and using 31,348,405 makes the Solo sum tie exactly (3,301,470,000+89,277,265+31,348,405=3,422,095,670) -- the parent 'Total provision' figure used for provision_charge_cumulative was printed correctly throughout and required no adjustment.
